name: Night Drive
author: Crosswar
description:
Night Drive is a game where you find yourself driving because why not!
What to do:
Keep driving
Pick up fuel and health
What not to do:
Crash into cars
And watch out for that reverse pickup!


Intensive puzzle resolution by Komiku used during driving under the public domain license.
